ideas.title: Multi-level leakage stress test for brain MRI segmentation

hypothesis.statement: Compared with random-slice splitting, patient- and acquisition-site-disjoint evaluation yields a mean Dice decrease exceeding 0.03 on sufficiently heterogeneous, legitimately obtained datasets; a preregistered study would test this prediction.
hypothesis.null_hypothesis: No preregistered improvement or degradation beyond the threshold

method_sketch.steps: On licensed multi-site segmentation data, compare random-slice, patient-disjoint and site-holdout splits with the same architecture and fixed tuning budget. Report bootstrapped site-cluster intervals and repeat seeds.

falsifier.statement: Reject the preregistered overoptimism hypothesis if the paired mean Dice gap is at most 0.03.

expected_outcomes.if_negative: Reject or narrow the hypothesis and document the negative result without altering the preregistration.
